description: We are Space Girlss! We are an enthusiastic team of curious, innovative 6th-grade students with a deep passion for science, technology, and space exploration.
summary:
With some data obtained from NASA, we prepared a project for you. In this project, we researched the dangerous areas on Mars and prepared a map. Places on this map can be exemplified by Olympus Mars. As a backup against possible interruptions in radio signals, we prepared something that they can carry with them. 

While creating this map, we did not get help for anything related to the project except for uploading. We equipped all of this with NASA's own data. We did not use anything for artificial intelligence. We tried to prepare the most suitable project for you. As a result, we prepared a project that we are satisfied with and believe you will be satisfied with as well. The reason we prepared this project is completely different. Here, we now believe that there could be life on Mars. While preparing the life there, we also need to be ready for approaching dangers. Our purpose is necessary, our hope is full, and our pride is complete. Respectfully, Space Girls present.
details: My team and I created this project to make life on Mars easier. If there is life on Mars or any mission there, they can carry this map as a backup. Even though it's not technological, it's a good thing because there's no internet communication in space. We didn't use any software for this map, just NASA's own data.
